name: Omni La Costa Resort
insider_take: This legendary Carlsbad resort has been the ultimate Southern California wellness destination since 1965, where Hollywood stars and sports legends have come to train, rejuvenate, and play on championship golf courses.
whats_special: Home to the famous Chopra Center for Wellbeing and two PGA Tour-quality golf courses designed by Dick Wilson. The resort sits on 400 sprawling acres and features the largest resort spa on the West Coast. It's also been the spring training facility for numerous professional sports teams.
pro_tip: Book spa treatments early morning or late afternoon to avoid peak times, and don't miss the signature HydraFacial that celebrities swear by.
dont_miss: The nearby Flower Fields at Carlsbad Ranch (March-May) create a stunning 50-acre rainbow of giant tecolote ranunculus flowers. LEGOLAND California is just 10 minutes away, and the charming Carlsbad Village offers beach access and local dining gems.
pros: Championship golf courses designed by Dick Wilson
Award-winning spa with extensive wellness facilities
Multiple swimming pools and family-friendly amenities
Spacious resort grounds with beautiful landscaping
cons: Resort fees apply for amenities usage
Large property requiring walking or shuttle transportation
